verses.text: This is what the LORD says: "The people of Moab have sinned again and again, and I will not hold back their punishment. They burned the bones of Edom's king until they turned to lime.
So I will send fire on Moab, and it will burn down the fortresses of Kerioth. Moab will die in the noise of battle, with war cries and the blast of the trumpet.
I will destroy its ruler and kill all its officials with him," says the LORD.

This is what the LORD says: "The people of Judah have sinned again and again, and I will not hold back their punishment. They have rejected the law of the LORD and have not kept his rules. They have been led astray by the same false gods their ancestors followed.
So I will send fire on Judah, and it will burn down the fortresses of Jerusalem."
This is what the LORD says: "The people of Israel have sinned again and again, and I will not hold back their punishment. They sell honest people for silver and needy people for a pair of sandals.
They trample the heads of the poor into the dust and push the oppressed out of the way. A man and his father sleep with the same young woman, and so they dishonor my holy name.
They lie down beside every altar on clothes they took from the poor as security for loans. In the house of their god they drink wine paid for with fines they forced people to pay.
"Yet I destroyed the Amorites ahead of them, though they were as tall as cedars and as strong as oaks. I destroyed their fruit above and their roots below.
I brought you up out of Egypt and led you through the wilderness for forty years, so that you could take the land of the Amorites.
I chose some of your sons to be prophets and some of your young men to be Nazirites. Isn't this true, people of Israel?" says the LORD.
"But you made the Nazirites drink wine, and you ordered the prophets, 'Do not prophesy!'
"Now I will crush you down, as a cart crushes when it is loaded with grain.
Even the fastest runners will not get away. The strong will lose their strength, and the mighty soldiers will not be able to save themselves.
Those who shoot arrows will not stand their ground. Fast runners will not escape, and riders on horses will not save themselves.
Even the bravest soldiers will run away naked on that day," says the LORD.
